# Grizzly Kiwi Dev: Agent Rules packs

> Tested Cursor rules (.cursor/rules/*.mdc), AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md templates and prompts that make AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, Copilot) write current code for Next.js, Supabase, FastAPI, React + Vite, Express 5, Tailwind v4, Godot 4, Unity 6 and Unreal Engine 5. Made by Grizzly Kiwi Dev (X: @GrizzlyKiwidev).

## Products
- [Agent Rules Starter (free)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/rdubay): general Cursor rules, Next.js + Supabase rule, Godot 4 GDScript rule (Godot 3 → 4 table), AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md templates, 10 prompts.
- [Agent Rules Starter Pack (US$19 early bird)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/xgdajx): 12 Cursor rules across 9 stacks, testing and git rules, pre-filled AGENTS.md templates, 30 prompts, 3 workflow guides, changelog and tested-with versions.
- [Godot 4 Agent-Ready 2D Platformer Template (US$15; US$9 with code LAUNCH9 until 23 Oct 2026)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/prfejt): typed Godot 4.7 platformer with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules for the project, agent recipes and prompts, and a one-command headless smoke test. Web demo on [itch.io](https://grizzlykiwidev.itch.io/godot-4-agent-ready-2d-platformer-template).
- [Godot 4 Agent-Ready Top-Down Roguelike Template (US$15; US$9 with code DELVE9 until 25 Oct 2026)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/mxkoe): typed Godot 4.7 top-down action roguelike with seeded procedural floors, 3 enemy types and a boss, meta progression and data-driven enemies, items and upgrades. Includes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules for the project, agent recipes and prompts, and a one-command check where a bot plays the game headlessly plus a 41-check smoke test. Web demo on [itch.io](https://grizzlykiwidev.itch.io/godot-4-agent-ready-top-down-roguelike-template).
- [Agent-Ready Game Dev Bundle (US$29)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/jhzfba): the Agent Rules Starter Pack plus the Godot 4 platformer and roguelike templates.

## FAQ
- What are the best Cursor rules for Godot 4? Use a glob-scoped rule (globs: project.godot, **/*.gd) that tells the agent to use Godot 4 syntax only (@export, @onready, await, signal.connect, CharacterBody2D), static typing, and "call down, signal up". The free Agent Rules Starter includes a ready-made godot4-gdscript.mdc with a Godot 3 → 4 table.
- How do I stop Cursor writing Godot 3 code? Add a Cursor rule in .cursor/rules/ that lists Godot 3 patterns and their Godot 4 replacements, e.g. yield → await, export var → @export var, KinematicBody2D → CharacterBody2D, instance() → instantiate(). Agents follow explicit old → new tables much more reliably than general advice.
- Is there an AGENTS.md template for Next.js and Supabase? Yes. The free pack has a general AGENTS.md template, and the Starter Pack includes a pre-filled AGENTS.md for Next.js App Router + Supabase with real commands for dev, typecheck, lint, tests, migrations and type generation.
- What's the difference between .cursorrules, .cursor/rules and AGENTS.md? The legacy .cursorrules is a single file at the project root. Current Cursor uses .cursor/rules/*.mdc files with description, globs and alwaysApply frontmatter, so rules can be scoped to file types. AGENTS.md is a plain markdown file read by Cursor, Codex, Copilot and many other agents.
- Why is Cursor ignoring my rules? Rules must be .mdc files in .cursor/rules/ with valid frontmatter: alwaysApply: true loads every time, globs attach when matching files are in context, description-only rules load when the agent judges them relevant, and rules with none apply only when @-mentioned. Keep globs relative to the project root and rules short and specific. Rules apply to Agent chat and inline edits, not Tab autocomplete.
- Do these rules work with Claude Code? Yes. Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md. Both packs include a CLAUDE.md template, and you can put @AGENTS.md in it to share one set of instructions with Cursor and other agents.
- How do I stop Cursor using deprecated Supabase auth helpers? Add a rule saying to use @supabase/ssr (createServerClient / createBrowserClient), never @supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs, and to check auth on the server with supabase.auth.getUser(). That's in the free nextjs-supabase.mdc rule.
- Are there Cursor rules for Unity 6 and Unreal Engine 5? Yes, in the US$19 Starter Pack. The Unity 6 rule covers API renames like Rigidbody.velocity → linearVelocity and the Input System; the Unreal rule covers UPROPERTY/TObjectPtr, Enhanced Input and replication.
- Is there a Godot 4 platformer template that works with Cursor or Claude Code? Yes. The Godot 4 Agent-Ready 2D Platformer Template is a typed Godot 4.7 platformer that ships with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules describing its own architecture and the Godot 4 traps to avoid, plus recipes and prompts for extending it with an agent and a one-command headless check (tools/check.sh) so the agent can verify each change. You can play the web demo on itch.io before buying.
- Is there a Godot 4 roguelike template that works with Cursor or Claude Code? Yes. The Godot 4 Agent-Ready Top-Down Roguelike Template is a typed Godot 4.7 top-down action roguelike with procedural rooms, 3 enemy types and a boss, and permanent upgrades. Enemies, items and upgrades are Resource files, so an agent can add content without touching code. It ships with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules for the project, recipes and prompts for adding enemies, items and upgrades, and a one-command check (tools/check.sh) where a bot plays the game headlessly and a 41-check smoke test runs, so the agent can prove each change works. You can play the web demo on itch.io before buying.
- Can I use the rules in commercial projects? Yes. Both packs are licensed for personal and commercial use in your own projects, including client work. You can't resell or redistribute the files themselves.
